A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same work and contain readable main text, Tables 1-10, Figures 1-5, Algorithm 1, and Appendices A-E. The material supports reliable comparison, including the added appendix subsections.

before.justification: v1 reports original scene-layout experiments and ablations, iterative correction results, and a user study involving 10 users and 18 correction examples (Section 4 and Appendices A-B).

after.justification: v2 retains these original quantitative experiments and user-study outcomes, and adds written observations of system failures in Appendix E.3.

M1.justification: The architecture, joint training, infilling procedure, positional embeddings, egocentric anchoring, and correction actions are unchanged. Section 3 clarifies the point-cloud-only input and decoder terminology; v1 already describes the same implementation.

E1.justification: Coverage remains ASE, iASE, AEO, and the existing real-world layout demonstrations and user-study tasks. Appendix E.2 explicitly associates its demonstrations with the existing Figure 1/4 scenes. The failure descriptions introduce no separate dataset or evaluation task.

E2.justification: The SceneScript baseline and comparison variants remain unchanged across the corresponding experiments. PanoAnnotator is newly discussed in Section 5 but is not experimentally evaluated. Appendix D retains the same cited RoomFormer results.

E3.justification: Both versions retain the model configuration, 500k training iterations, preprocessing, AvgF1 and PlaneDistance metrics, 50-step refinement experiment, and 10-user/18-example study. The new failure descriptions do not specify a changed evaluation procedure.

E4.justification: Appendix E.3 adds a short qualitative failure analysis covering closely spaced windows, unexpected placement of added entities, and incorrect small-window geometry. Existing ablations, multi-wall analysis, and accumulated-point comparison remain unchanged. The added evidence here consists of the PDF's written case descriptions.

E5.justification: Both versions report averaging the heuristic correction experiment over five trials. Neither adds seed information, confidence intervals, significance tests, or another uncertainty-reporting procedure.

E6.justification: Tables 1-10, Figure 3, and the user-study percentages are unchanged. Appendix E.3 newly reports qualitative failures, including added entities appearing away from the expected location and unsuccessful reconstruction of small-window geometry; these are additional observations, not numerical performance changes.

T1.justification: The task assumptions, mathematical notation, ordering arguments, and Algorithm 1 are unchanged. Neither version contains a theorem or proof contribution, and v2 introduces no new formal derivation.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same central claims about infilling, joint training, and iterative human-guided refinement. The introduction's added architectural scope and extensibility statements were already expressed in v1's method and discussion.

C2.justification: Appendix E.3 adds hypotheses linking failures to synthetic training data and visibility-based selection, and explicitly limits generalization to learned local distributions. Section 5 removes the earlier future-work discussion about additional infilling tasks, including object-motion updates.

D1.justification: v2 adds a project-page link and directions to demonstration and failure videos, with Appendix E.2 explaining their correspondence to existing scenes. Implementation settings and hardware disclosures remain unchanged; the PDFs establish no new code or data release.

R1.justification: Section 5 adds PanoAnnotator and positions the proposed one-click correction workflow against its continuous-value editing. Other cited works and research positioning remain substantially unchanged; RoomFormer and SceneLanguage are merely renumbered.

P1.justification: There are localized rewrites in the introduction, method description, and discussion, plus new Appendix E.2 and E.3 subsections. The overall section organization and most prose remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The existing figures and table structures are retained. Figure 1's caption gains a video pointer, and Figure 5 moves upward on the final page to accommodate the added appendix text. Other changes are limited text reflow and removal of printed page numbers.

improvement.justification: Appendix E.3 improves transparency by documenting concrete failures and qualifying the generalization claims that v1 presented more broadly. The PanoAnnotator discussion also clarifies positioning. These are useful, limited improvements; the method and quantitative evidence remain unchanged, and the proposed failure explanations are explicitly speculative.
